title: Geometry of Relaxed Fair Regression: A Unified Framework for Aware and Unaware Settings
abstract: arXiv:2605.28233v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fairness-accuracy trade-offs are a central concern in the deployment of fairness-aware machine learning methods. When sensitive attributes are unavailable at inference time-the so called unawareness setting, principled methods for obtaining accurate predictions under relaxed fairness constraints are largely missing. In this work, we address this gap by formulating regression under a demographic parity penalty as an optimal transport problem. Our framework, unifies both the aware and unaware settings and characterizes optimal prediction functions via optimal transport maps, under both squared Wasserstein-2 and Total Variation penalties. These results reveal that the choice of penalty reflects fundamentally different fairness philosophies: the Wasserstein penalty induces a smooth, population-wide compromise, while Total Variation enforces parity for a subset of individuals. translated_title: 弛豫公平回归的几何学：感知与无感知设置的统一框架
translated_abstract: 公平性与准确性之间的权衡是公平感知机器学习方法部署中的核心问题。当敏感属性在推理阶段不可用时——即所谓的“无感知”设置——在松弛公平约束下获得准确预测的原则性方法在很大程度上是缺失的。在本工作中，我们通过将在人口均等惩罚下的回归问题表述为一个最优传输问题来填补这一空白。我们的框架统一了感知与无感知两种设置，并在平方Wasserstein-2惩罚与全变差惩罚下，借助最优传输映射刻画了最优预测函数。这些结果揭示了惩罚项的选择反映了根本不同的公平哲学：Wasserstein惩罚带来一种平滑的、面向全体人群的折中，而全变差惩罚则对个体的某个子集强制实现均等。基于这些理论刻画，我们提出……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文将感知与无感知设置下的弛豫公平回归统一表述为最优传输问题，刻画了最优预测函数，并揭示Wasserstein惩罚体现全体人群的平滑折中而全变差惩罚强制子集均等这两种根本不同的公平哲学。
en_tdlr: This paper unifies aware and unaware relaxed fair regression as an optimal transport problem, characterizes optimal predictors via transport maps, and reveals fundamentally distinct fairness philosophies: Wasserstein penalties yield smooth population-wide compromises, while Total Variation enforces parity for a subset of individuals.
